description: A false-colour infrared satellite image depicts a diverse European landscape, likely used for land cover/land use mapping within the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS). The image features a wide, winding river flowing from the upper-left to the lower-right, characterized by a significant bend in the upper-central area. Water bodies, including the river and two distinct lakes/reservoirs in the upper-central part, appear as dark blue or black. Urban and built-up settlements are prominent in bright turquoise and cyan, clustered along the riverbanks and extending into the surrounding terrain. Dense, healthy vegetation, such as forests and some actively growing agricultural fields, is represented by shades of deep red and magenta. Agricultural land consists of numerous parcels displaying varying colours from lighter reds and pinks to teal and light green, indicating different crop types, stages of growth, or bare soil. The image provides a detailed view of natural watercourses, extensive forested areas, and a patchwork of agricultural fields, illustrating the interplay of different land cover types in the region. No specific geographic location, scale bar, or date is visible.
